title: Project charter — Corporate Knowledge Assistant
summary: Initial hypothesis for an assistant that gives employees trustworthy answers from company documents, enforcing role-based access, citing sources, and refusing unsupported answers.
notes: Type set by manifest (PRD). Document is a thin, unfilled template stub (Italian) containing only an initial hypothesis paragraph; requirements are implicit: answers limited to user's role, sources shown, unsupported answers refused. Filename hash suffix is a placeholder (00000000) because no hashing tool was available to compute SHA-256 of the source path.
